Container.Name: webui-manager
Container.Overview: A self-hosted Flask app for organizing and launching your internal web services. Stores service URLs grouped by host with optional credentials, category tags, and auto-discovered favicons.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Your UTC TZ offset for database timestamp recording. List of available TZs: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones

Config.Name: DB_HOST
Config.Description: Your MariaDB/MySQL database host or container name

Config.Name: DB_USER
Config.Description: The designated user for this application in the database. For more info on the requirements, please visit: https://github.com/nullata/webui-manager/blob/main/README.md#database-setup

Config.Name: DB_NAME
Config.Description: Your MariaDB/MySQL database name. For more info on the requirements, please visit: https://github.com/nullata/webui-manager/blob/main/README.md#database-setup

Config.Name: DB_PARAMS
Config.Description: Additional database connection string parameters. Make sure to set a value for charset matching your database. Default: ?charset=utf8mb4

Config.Name: SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Flask session secret. Required for multi-replica deployments. Leave blank for auto-generated per restart.

Config.Name: APP_CREDENTIALS_KEY
Config.Description: Key used to encrypt stored credentials at rest. Leave blank for auto-generated per restart.

Config.Name: SESSION_COOKIE_NAME
Config.Description: Name of the session cookie. Only change this if you run several copies of WebUI Manager on the same hostname and want each to keep its own login. Default: webui_manager_session

Config.Name: AUTO_MIGRATE
Config.Description: Run automatic schema migration on startup. Default: true
